# Appwrite browser SDK

`appwrite-28.1.0.js` is the unmodified official browser bundle previously loaded by this landing page from:

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/appwrite@28.1.0

It is served locally so that rendering and checkout initialization do not depend on another script host. The SDK version and account/payment API contracts are unchanged. The original BSD 3-Clause license is included in `appwrite-LICENSE.txt`.

Download/update only over verified HTTPS. Do not update the SDK as part of a visual-only change without rerunning account, checkout and login tests.

Bundle SHA-256: `6ea911fcdb1ade19f204fe3dc88682403e5e1afb4f65864a77008519a52110ef`
